summary: Gorax showcases an all-in summoning session on the Option Summons II banner, selecting Toxic and Dauntless damage schools. He highlights Option Summons II as the best opportunity for players to assemble specialized elemental team comps like Toxic, Ice Blast, or Dauntless. During the pulls, he acquires key heroes including Oggok, Urgoula, Durango, Irmoush, and main Dauntless carry Guinavivre. He also details how to use the Starwave Echo anniversary event to convert extra legendary soul imprints into exclusive heroes like Maashtur or Kurvida.

heroes.name: Oggok
heroes.note: Wants high inspiration, especially Inspiration 5 which allows him to bypass Accuracy stats completely.

heroes.name: Urgoula
heroes.verdict: Excellent PvP tank and control hero
heroes.note: Provides Stun, Attack Penalty, huge shield, and dispel; helped creator reach Rank 1 Arena.

heroes.name: Durango
heroes.verdict: Great Toxic enabler for PvP and PvE
heroes.note: Applies Toxic stacks immediately at battle start to trigger Serpentemis for high early damage.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.verdict: Main damage carry for Dauntless teams
heroes.note: Becomes a top-tier damage dealer at Inspiration 5 where her battle skill bonus damage chance increases from 50% to 100%.

heroes.name: Irmoush
heroes.note: Grants Defense Up II, Debuff Immunity, and Control Immunity upon switching stances.

heroes.name: Elip
heroes.note: Has limited utility in end-game PvE or Continental content and is rarely prioritized.

heroes.name: Vicana
heroes.note: Rarely used due to superior Toxic options like Serpentemis; best converted to artifacts or tokens.

heroes.name: Tamar
heroes.note: Has utility in PvP, but duplicate copies are frequently converted into artifacts or Starwave tokens.

teams.note: Dauntless is the strongest single-target team composition in the game, though highly expensive to build.
Toxic teams are easy to construct for F2P players via Option Summons banners.

meta_changes: Ice Blast teams gain a strong buff in the upcoming season through a new exclusive support hero.
Starwave Echo event allows exchanging duplicate Legendary Hero Soul Imprints for Starwave Fragments to purchase premium heroes.
tips: The 300-summon selector on Option Summons II effectively requires only 270 dice due to refunded dice rewards.
Target Inspiration 5 on Guinavivre to turn her battle skill proc chance from 50% into a guaranteed 100%.
Join the Nightveil Vanguard / Dark Lady faction in the Nightveil Standoff event to claim maximum participation rewards.
title: I Went ALL IN on Option Summons II… Should You? | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
